title: Fourteen Nights in Peru
subtitle: Add stops, set the nights, rewrite any of them, invent your own. Dates recompute as you go, and the checks below flag anything that will bite you — altitude, travel days, and whether the plan still has a macaw in it.
label: Starting plan

items.vibe: Explore the city, take it easy, maybe Colca Canyon.
Cusco and Machu Picchu, with some time to chill.

items.note: Either north to Máncora and Vichayito for the beach — or skip the north, stay longer around Cusco and go into the jungle from there.
